summary: Two lost hikers at Button Rock Reservoir (~7 mi west of Lyons): a 12-year-old female got separated from her group while hiking, and a 16-year-old male left the group on his own to search for her; a Button Rock ranger located both safe and uninjured, assisted them back to the trailhead, and reunited them with their families (~2-hr response; BCSO case 21-3869)
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Lyons Fire Protection District, Boulder County Mounted Search and Rescue Group (cancelled)
